coaching_notes: with these market conditions with stocks not holding their gains very well at the open after they have these Gap UPS it's very important to manage your risk on these trades so you don't end up holding through these big pullbacks in these big sell-offs like we saw with nuwe and like we saw with Lucy as well

it's also important to learn what to look for in the stocks that have a better setup for a gap and go so that way you're in a better position to to catch the stocks like vcig that actually continue to carry their momentum into the market hours

one thing that I really have an issue with is getting in and out of Trades locking in profits and then taking those stocks off of my radar so I end up missing out on these second runs and these second spikes
one thing that I really need to work on is keeping track of these stocks even after I exit them and even after I sell my shares waiting for a second opportunity to buy into them

instrument_classification.notes: Small-cap momentum stocks traded on the cash equities open (shares, pre-market gappers); not futures.

confluences.description: as always opening range breakout levels for the stocks with the biggest potential for a gap and go are posted every single morning in the market Master group
one of those things that is often a Telltale sign that this has potential to be a bigger Gap and go is that it's able to actually break above the V web

with nuwe over here it rejects V web immediately at the market open it rejects for you up again into this second bounce same thing happens with Lucy opens under the V web and at no point in time during the market hours was it able to actually break back above
this one actually never got above its opening range breakout level there was just no follow-through whatsoever at the open
we can see very quickly it breaks only seven cents above that opening range breakout level and then come straight back down

entry_sequence.action: if we focus on the pre-market session here in the open we can see it spikes up trade sideways consolidates into the open and we get ourselves an opening range breakout level
an opening range breakout level which is the high of this first five minute candle of 3.94 cents
a few minutes later it starts to break out above that 394 level that's when I took a starter position in this trade

strategies.name: gap_and_go_opening_range_breakout

targets.description: I take some profits initially up in the 420s on this initial Spike
then I took some profits as it's trading sideways and consolidating here above the V web
I saw it consolidating started to form some lower highs all of those were bearish signals for me I took profits on the trade

a lot of times when we get this breakout in the morning and then that consolidation period That's often what ends up being the top of this move and from there we'll see stocks many times fall back under v-wap fade back to their low a day and end up making lows
